test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 31 is related to 94 in a certain way. Following the same logic, 37 is related to 112. To which of the following is 63 related, following the same logic?
solution:
**Logic: Second no. = [(First no. × 3) + 1]**

31 is related to 94 →

​⇒ [(31 × 3) + 1]

​⇒ (93 + 1) = 94

37 is related to 112 →</sp
